## Access Control Review

Access control is reviewed monthly for privileged roles. The Identity Administration
team exports the access review report, removes inactive accounts, and records owner
approval for exceptions. This implemented access control procedure is documented,
approved, and regularly monitored.

| Account reference | Role | Review outcome |
|---|---|---|
| USER-REDACTED-001 | admin | removed |
| USER-REDACTED-002 | finance approver | approved by owner |

The access review export is redacted before pilot sharing and contains no personal names,
emails, or production identifiers.
